kewajaran: ok (この みせの コーヒーは あまり おいしくないです). A says その レストラン and B answers この みせ, which fits the usual ko/so pairing only if B is at the restaurant (e.g. A is phoning B). A situasi such as （電話{でんわ}で） would make this clear. Not a failure.
tingkat: Fails: うーん is Bab 28 vocabulary in the Minna list (16-kosakata-minna.md, Bab 28), and this item is Bab 8. Everything else is fine: この (Bab 2), コーヒー (Bab 2), みせ (Bab 6), レストラン / あまり / おいしくないです / どうですか (Bab 8).
catatan: All 24 orders checked. あまり おいしくないです is the only predicate, so it goes last. この must come right before a noun, and みせの must modify コーヒー, so 4-2-1 is the only order that works. The ★ (みせの) follows from the modifier structure. Fix: replace うーん、 with そうですね、 (Bab 8), or drop it.

kewajaran: ok (なごやまでの 電車の きっぷを もう 買いました). It is a natural answer to 'You are going to Nagoya tomorrow, right?'
tingkat: ok: もう Vました (Bab 7), きっぷ (Bab 7), 電車 (Bab 5), 行きます / へ (Bab 5), あした (Bab 4), まで (Bab 4) + の (Bab 2). なごや is a proper place name, which is allowed. Note: Nまでの N is not listed as its own pattern in 15-tata-bahasa-minna.md, but it is simply まで + の and is normal at JLPT N5.
catatan: もう 買いました is the only predicate, so it goes in box 4. きっぷを is the head noun with its object marker, so it must come right before it. The two modifiers なごやまでの and 電車の can swap: 電車の なごやまでの きっぷを is a little less natural but still acceptable. Either way きっぷを stays in box 3 (★), so there is no ganda.
